/preprocess.description: Removes background if requested, returns processed image

/generate_mvs.description: Generates 6-view multiview image via InstantMesh diffusion, varying by seed

/make3d.description: Reconstructs 3D mesh from multiview via InstantMesh, using server-side state from generate_mvs

INPUT_SCHEMA.reference_image: Path to reference image (PNG/JPG/WEBP) - passed as handle_file

OUTPUT_SCHEMA.obj: Model3D filepath (OBJ + MTL if present), from /make3d first output
OUTPUT_SCHEMA.metadata: JSON with timing, params, sizes, view_api, logs

NOTES: Stateful pipeline: preprocess -> generate_mvs (consumes ZeroGPU 60s) -> make3d uses server-side state (id 29). Must reuse same Client instance per generation. handle_file required for image uploads (gradio_client 2.6.1). ZeroGPU free quota approx 120s/day; 2x75-step generations exhaust free tier, third seed blocked until quota reset or PRO.
